injuries.name: Pavel Mintyukov
injuries.note: Mintyukov last played Tuesday against the Islanders, so this move might be retroactive to that date. Travis Mitchell was summoned from AHL San Diego in a corresponding move. Mintyukov had two assists, two PIM, five shots, one hit and 16 blocks in nine appearances before sustaining the injury. Nick Jensen might play regularly during Mintyukov's absence.

injuries.name: Judd Caulfield
injuries.note: Caulfield will remain with his family for a while longer after leaving the Ducks' road trip for the birth of his child. At this point, it seems doubtful he'll be available for Saturday's game versus the Flyers, but he could be back in action Tuesday versus the Canucks once the Ducks have returned home.

injuries.name: Ian Moore
injuries.note: Moore has been on injured reserve since the start of the regular season due to a lower-body injury he sustained on the first day of training camp. While he was given a return timetable of 2-4 weeks in mid-September, he's slated to miss more time than that, and he seems to have several steps to clear before he's in the mix to return to game action.

injuries.name: Ryan Poehling
injuries.note: Poehling was placed on injured reserve Tuesday morning, and the specifics of his injury have revealed that he's set to likely be sidelined into late November. In his absence, Roger McQueen, the 10th overall pick from the 2025 NHL Entry Draft, is expected to play in the team's middle six up the center of the ice. The 27-year-old Poehling was off to a solid start to the 2026-27 campaign prior to going down, posting a pair of points and solid category-coverage numbers across five games.

injuries.name: Troy Terry
injuries.note: Terry isn't expected to be back until mid-November at the earliest, so this transfer doesn't impact his timetable. He had 19 goals and 57 points in 61 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. Terry should occupy a top-six role and play on the first power-play unit once he's healthy.

injuries.name: Connor Hellebuyck
injuries.note: While the full details of the trade haven't yet been revealed, the trade call has been completed, and players involved are being informed. Hellebuyck was suspended by the Jets to begin the 2026-27 campaign amid his looming trade request, but he'll presumably be available for the Devils shortly after he joins the team. The three-time Vezina Trophy winner made 57 regular-season appearances for Winnipeg last year, going 23-23-11 with a 2.86 GAA and .895 save percentage.

injuries.name: Seamus Casey
injuries.note: Casey figures to miss at least 19 more games if he is on the short end of his recovery timeline. While it's certainly a blow that will stretch the Devils' defensive depth, Casey would likely have served as a healthy scratch more often than not. Once given the all-clear, the 22-year-old Florida native could be headed to the minors in order to get his legs back under him.

injuries.name: Judd Caulfield
injuries.note: Personal: Caulfield is Questionable for Thursday's (Oct. 22) game versus the Devils.

injuries.name: Jeff Malott
injuries.note: Illness: Malott won't play Thursday (Oct. 22) versus the Devils.

injuries.name: Pavel Mintyukov
injuries.note: Lower Body: Mintyukov returned to Anaheim on Thursday (Oct. 22) and won't play for the last two games of the road trip.

injuries.name: Ian Moore
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Ducks said on Friday (Oct. 16) that Moore remains without timetable to return.

injuries.name: Ryan Poehling
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Ducks said on Tuesday (Oct. 13) that Poehling is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.

injuries.name: Troy Terry
injuries.note: Hip: The Anaheim Ducks placed F Troy Terry on long-term injured reserve on Wednesday (Sept. 30).

injuries.name: Nick Bjugstad
injuries.note: Pectoral: The New Jersey Devils placed F Nick Bjugstad on long-term injured reserve on Friday (Oct. 9).

injuries.name: Seamus Casey
injuries.note: Knee: The New Jersey Devils said on Friday (Oct. 2) that Casey will miss 8-10 weeks after undergoing knee surgery.
